definitions.explanation: In a way that makes little or no noise. Used as a command to tell someone to be quiet, or to describe actions done without making sound.
In a calm, undisturbed manner. Describes doing something without haste, excitement, or agitation.

examples.japanese: {静|しず}かに⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{静|しず}かに⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The baby is sleeping, so walk quietly.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{静|しず}かに⟦{閉|し}めた→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{静|しず}かに⟦{微笑|ほほえ}んだ→微笑む：02416_hohoemu⟧。
{静|しず}かに⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{静|しず}かに{降|ふ}り⟦{積|つ}もって→積もる：01964_tsumoru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The snow was quietly piling up.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Adverbial form of the na-adjective ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧. Functions as an adverb modifying verbs. Also used as a command: {静|しず}かに！(Be quiet!)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {静|しず}かに⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be quiet; to keep quiet)
- {静|しず}かに⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ (to live peacefully)
- {静|しず}かに⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to speak softly)
- {静|しず}かに⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait quietly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おとなしく: obediently, meekly — implies compliance
- ⟦そっと→そっと：03321_sotto⟧: softly, stealthily — emphasizes gentleness or secrecy
- ⟦ひっそり→ひっそり：10473_hissori⟧: in seclusion, inconspicuously — emphasizes being unnoticed
